name: Chou Jikuu Bakuren Monogatari ~Door☆Pi☆Chu~
source:
Yoshitsune lives with his childhood friends, sisters Orihime and Otohime. Otohime likes delving in black magic and one day makes a drug that bend space and time. Yoshitsune ends up getting this power and summons lots of historical figures. However, he can’t make them return to their original time, so they end up living together with him.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/04/02/april-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
义经与青梅竹马织姬、乙姬姐妹共同生活。乙姬喜欢钻研黑魔法，有一天还制作出一种能够扭曲时空的药物。结果，义经获得了这股力量，并召唤出许多历史人物。然而，他无法把他们送回原本的时代，于是众人只好与他一起生活。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/04/02/april-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
